state: My card was stolen this morning and there are two payments on it that I did not make.

queue.instructions: Which support queue should handle this customer message?

criteria.cards: Ordering, delivering, activating, linking or replacing cards; PINs, card limits and card support.
criteria.payments: Card payments, cash withdrawals, refunds, fees, exchange rates and currencies.
criteria.transfers: Sending and receiving money, transfer status, cancellations and beneficiaries.
criteria.top_up: Topping up the account and problems with top-ups or deposits.
criteria.account: Identity verification, personal details, passcodes, age limits and closing the account.
criteria.security: Lost, stolen or compromised cards or phones, and transactions the customer does not recognise.

urgent.instructions: Could the customer lose money or access to their account if this message waits until tomorrow?
